biggest_catch: There is a $0 annual fee, so the $200 bonus is yours to keep net — but you only get one bonus per new account, and the account must be open with charging privileges when the bonus posts, so don't close or freeze it early.
catches: Only pursue spending you already planned to do — never overspend just to chase a bonus; buying things to hit a threshold wipes out the bonus math and is how people lose money on this.
You must spend at least $1,000 in purchases within the first 90 days — keep it to your already-planned spending.
Only one new-account bonus per account; the account must be open with charging privileges when the bonus posts.
Applying triggers a hard credit inquiry, which can temporarily dip your credit score by a few points.
The card's variable APR (around 20%+) will erase the entire bonus in a month or two if you carry a balance — pay the full statement balance every month.
